workflows.title: Two-week product launch campaign
workflows.scenario: A funded software company has promising beta feedback and wants strategy, creative, and launch support. The product has not yet generated revenue.
facts: Planning cases put the four packages in overlapping payout ranges

fields.label: Compensation package
fields.help: Choose the payment structure you would put in the proposal.

options.text: $18,000 fixed fee with a 50% deposit.
$14,000 fixed plus a $5,000 launch-target bonus.
$9,000 retainer plus 8% of first-quarter revenue, capped at $45,000 total.
$5,000 upfront plus 20% of first-quarter revenue, uncapped.

fields.label: Delivery commitment
fields.help: Choose how much work and expense to commit before results are known.

options.text: Reserve the full team and launch the stretch concept now; campaign costs are covered and an $18,000 bonus depends on the launch target.
Reserve the full delivery window and begin the ambitious creative package; $7,000 is tied to final approval.
Commit to the core launch, adding stretch work after a signed milestone.
Start with a paid discovery sprint, then decide whether to reserve delivery capacity.

workflows.title: Seasonal brand partnership
workflows.scenario: A growing outdoor brand wants a complete winter campaign. Its previous seasonal launch sold well, while this year's inventory and media reach are substantially larger.
facts: Client forecasts give the variable packages plausible payouts near the fixed offers

fields.label: Compensation package
fields.help: Choose the proposed mix of guaranteed payment and campaign upside.

options.text: $20,000 guaranteed plus a $4,000 delivery bonus.
$25,000 fixed fee paid by the first shoot date.
$6,000 guaranteed plus 12% of campaign-attributed gross margin, uncapped.
$11,000 guaranteed plus 6% of campaign-attributed gross margin, capped at $60,000.

fields.label: Production commitment
fields.help: Choose the scope you would lock before sales data arrives.

options.text: Book the full crew and locations, with a reduced fallback shoot and a $7,000 campaign-performance bonus.
Lock the largest production plan and one weather-dependent travel window; hard costs are covered and a $16,000 bonus depends on sales.
Produce one paid test concept before booking the campaign.
Reserve a small local shoot and expand only after the first preorder report.

workflows.title: Enterprise sales-enablement rollout
workflows.scenario: A robotics startup wants a library of demos and sales materials before its first national trade show. Several enterprise prospects are interested, with no signed contracts yet.
facts: Eleven prospects create a wide but credible contract-value range

fields.label: Compensation package
fields.help: Choose the commercial structure for the proposal.

options.text: $42,000 fixed across four milestones.
$34,000 fixed plus $2,000 for each signed enterprise pilot, capped at five.
$18,000 retainer plus 3% of first-year contract value, capped at $90,000.
$9,000 upfront plus 8% of first-year contract value, uncapped.

fields.label: Capacity commitment
fields.help: Choose how much capacity to reserve before contracts close.

options.text: Reserve the complete rollout team now; outside specialist costs are covered and most of the fee is earned only as enterprise pilots sign.
Reserve the full fourteen-week window and build all trade-show assets, with one-third of the fee tied to qualified leads.
Build the core demo library, adding industry variants after signed pilots.
Deliver a paid prototype and reserve later capacity only after one contract signs.

workflows.title: Performance-linked product photography
workflows.scenario: A direct-to-consumer brand needs launch photography for a new premium line. The founder offers attribution access so compensation can be tied to sales.
facts: Attribution scenarios make each package commercially credible

fields.label: License and payment
fields.help: Choose the proposed commercial package.

options.text: $13,000 fixed plus a $2,000 on-time bonus.
$16,000 fixed with standard two-year usage.
$4,000 creative fee plus 7% of attributed sales for three years, uncapped.
$7,000 fixed plus 3% of attributed sales, capped at $35,000 total.

fields.label: Production plan
fields.help: Choose the production exposure you would accept.

options.text: Book the studio and specialist crew around a new visual concept, while retaining a smaller fallback setup.
Anchor the campaign to a premium experimental set and one weather-dependent shoot; the client prepays hard costs and doubles the creative fee if it converts.
Run a paid tabletop test before committing to the main shoot.
Book a standard studio day with cancellation protection.

workflows.title: Illustration series licensing
workflows.scenario: A publisher is commissioning illustrations for the first title in a possible series. The manuscript tested well, while future volumes depend on sales.
facts: The publisher's sales cases put the royalty packages near the buyout in expected value
Series length: one to six titles

fields.label: License structure
fields.help: Choose the proposed payment and rights arrangement.

options.text: $28,000 guaranteed for the first title and a fixed reuse fee.
$22,000 guaranteed plus 2% of net sales for three years.
$11,000 advance plus 7% of net sales across the series, capped at $100,000.
$5,000 advance plus 15% of net sales for the life of the series, uncapped.

fields.label: Creative commitment
fields.help: Choose how much series work to begin before sales are available.

options.text: Reserve the six-title window and develop sequel concepts now; the first title is paid and the remaining fee and royalty step up only when renewals occur.
Reserve three title windows and develop concepts for the next two; half of the sequel concept fee depends on renewal.
Complete the first title and hold an option for one sequel.
Deliver a paid sample chapter before reserving the full first-title schedule.

workflows.title: Independent game soundtrack
workflows.scenario: A small studio has a playable game and strong festival reactions. Funding covers production, while commercial performance remains uncertain.
facts: Comparable games support both low and high revenue cases
Production vendors are covered by the studio

fields.label: Music rights package
fields.help: Choose the mix of fee, royalty, and ownership.

options.text: $24,000 guaranteed plus a small soundtrack-sales royalty.
$30,000 guaranteed as a complete buyout.
$6,000 guaranteed plus 8% of game net revenue and soundtrack ownership, uncapped.
$12,000 guaranteed plus 4% of game net revenue, capped at $75,000 total.

fields.label: Production commitment
fields.help: Choose the amount of production to commit before launch financing closes.

options.text: Produce the full score and a live-session package, retaining a synthetic fallback and tying $8,000 to launch.
Book the studio-funded orchestra and complete the expanded score before launch financing; $18,000 of compensation is contingent on release.
Deliver a paid vertical-slice score before reserving the production window.
Complete the core digital score, adding live sessions after launch funding.

workflows.title: Professional course licensing
workflows.scenario: An education platform wants a new specialist course. Its audience is established, although demand for this topic is based on survey interest rather than enrollments.
facts: The platform's demand cases give all four packages overlapping payout ranges

fields.label: Instructor compensation
fields.help: Choose how the course would be compensated.

options.text: $26,000 guaranteed for production and one year of updates.
$20,000 guaranteed plus $15 per completed enrollment, capped at $45,000.
$10,000 production fee plus 30% of net course revenue, capped at $90,000.
$5,000 production fee plus 55% of net course revenue, uncapped.

fields.label: Course scope
fields.help: Choose the scope to build before enrollment demand is observed.

options.text: Build the full course, advanced modules, and two live cohorts before presales; vendors are covered and most compensation tracks enrollments.
Reserve the full launch semester and build all planned modules, with a completion fee plus a capped enrollment bonus.
Build the core course, adding advanced modules after enrollment targets are met.
Release a paid workshop first and expand only after measured demand.

workflows.title: Subscription-funded research report
workflows.scenario: A policy forum wants a major independent report. Several organizations expressed interest, but subscriptions will only be confirmed after a public prospectus.
facts: Subscriber cases make fixed funding and revenue share similarly plausible

fields.label: Funding structure
fields.help: Choose how the research work would be funded.

options.text: $45,000 guaranteed plus a modest subscriber bonus.
$52,000 guaranteed across research milestones.
A $10,000 seed payment plus 65% of subscription revenue, uncapped.
$22,000 guaranteed plus 35% of subscription revenue, capped at $85,000.

fields.label: Research commitment
fields.help: Choose the scope to begin before subscriber commitments close.

options.text: Begin the full study and fieldwork, retaining a smaller publishable report and a capped subscriber bonus.
Launch the complete underwritten field study before subscriptions close; team costs are covered and most compensation comes from subscriber revenue.
Produce a paid scoping memo before beginning the full study.
Begin a limited dataset and expand after the first subscription threshold.

workflows.title: Multi-site training program
workflows.scenario: A healthcare network wants to pilot a staff workshop. A successful pilot may expand to 22 locations, subject to participant scores and regional budgets.
facts: Historic network rollouts range from 3 to 22 sites

fields.label: Facilitation package
fields.help: Choose how pilot and rollout compensation would work.

options.text: $16,000 guaranteed for the pilot and materials.
$12,000 guaranteed plus $1,500 for each of the first four rollout sites.
$7,000 pilot fee plus $2,400 per rollout site, capped at 16 sites.
$4,000 pilot fee plus $4,000 per rollout site with no cap.

fields.label: Program commitment
fields.help: Choose how much rollout work to prepare before pilot results.

options.text: Build every regional variant and reserve facilitators for all 22 sites; contractor costs are covered and fees are earned only as sites approve.
Prepare the complete rollout kit and hold dates for the first 12 sites, with a capped fee per approved site.
Build the pilot and a reusable core kit, adding variants after approval.
Deliver the paid pilot, then scope any rollout separately.

workflows.title: Interactive conference keynote
workflows.scenario: A new technology conference wants an interactive keynote built around live audience participation. Ticket sales are encouraging and the format has not been tested at this scale.
facts: Every format has passed the venue's safety review

fields.label: Speaker compensation
fields.help: Choose the proposed keynote fee structure.

options.text: $22,000 guaranteed plus a small ticket-sales bonus.
$27,000 guaranteed before the event.
$5,000 guaranteed plus 18% of event profit, uncapped.
$10,000 guaranteed plus 8% of event profit, capped at $60,000 total.

fields.label: Format commitment
fields.help: Choose the production format to lock before ticket sales finish.

options.text: Build the full audience-driven system with a rehearsed fixed-format fallback and a capped engagement bonus.
Let live audience choices determine the keynote's path; retain a technical failover and tie most compensation to attendance and engagement.
Prepare a conventional keynote and test one interactive segment.
Use a proven talk format with moderated audience questions.

workflows.title: Outdoor interactive installation
workflows.scenario: A city festival commissions an interactive installation. Attendance varies with weather, and sponsors may fund an expanded version after the prototype is announced.
facts: Direct materials are covered under every plan

fields.label: Commission structure
fields.help: Choose the proposed mix of fee and attendance-linked upside.

options.text: $38,000 guaranteed for a weather-resistant installation.
$30,000 guaranteed plus a $10,000 attendance milestone.
$16,000 creative fee plus 5% of ticket revenue, capped at $70,000 total.
$7,000 creative fee plus 12% of ticket and sponsor revenue, uncapped; materials remain covered.

fields.label: Build commitment
fields.help: Choose the installation scope to start before sponsorship is confirmed.

options.text: Start the full expanded installation now; materials are covered and the expansion fee depends on sponsorship and attendance.
Begin the full core installation and reserve expansion materials, with a capped sponsor milestone.
Build the core installation, adding sponsor-funded modules later.
Deliver a paid indoor prototype before committing to the outdoor build.

workflows.title: Documentary completion partnership
workflows.scenario: A documentary has strong footage and an unfinished edit. Festival acceptance and distribution are uncertain; the producer offers backend participation.
facts: The producer's distribution cases give backend packages credible parity with fixed fees

fields.label: Editing compensation
fields.help: Choose the proposed fee and backend arrangement.

options.text: $36,000 guaranteed plus a small festival bonus.
$42,000 guaranteed across delivery milestones.
$8,000 upfront plus 12% of producer net receipts, uncapped.
$18,000 guaranteed plus 5% of producer net receipts, capped at $80,000.

fields.label: Post-production commitment
fields.help: Choose the scope to commit before festival acceptance.

options.text: Complete the feature edit and sound package, keeping a shorter cut and a capped festival bonus.
Complete the full feature finish and festival campaign before acceptance; vendor costs are covered and most compensation is backend participation.
Deliver a paid fifteen-minute assembly before booking post-production.
Complete a festival-ready rough cut, adding the full finish after acceptance.

workflows.title: Pre-seed product prototype
workflows.scenario: A technical founding team needs a working prototype for investor meetings. Early interviews are encouraging, with no revenue or institutional funding yet.
facts: Independent valuation cases make the equity packages commercially credible

fields.label: Prototype compensation
fields.help: Choose the fee and ownership structure.

options.text: $48,000 guaranteed in four milestones.
$38,000 guaranteed plus a $12,000 financing-close bonus.
$20,000 guaranteed plus 0.5% equity, with a contractual value cap.
$9,000 guaranteed plus 1.8% equity, uncapped; direct expenses are covered.

fields.label: Venture commitment
fields.help: Choose how much work to commit before financing closes.

options.text: Reserve the full product team through fundraising; specialists are covered and most compensation is an additional equity grant that vests only if the prototype ships.
Reserve the full build window and deliver the investor-ready product, with a capped financing-close bonus.
Build the core prototype, expanding after a signed financing milestone.
Complete a paid technical discovery before reserving the build window.

workflows.title: Revenue-share retail pop-up
workflows.scenario: A food brand wants a holiday pop-up in an emerging district. Social interest is strong, while this city has no prior sales history.
facts: The brand covers inventory and the space deposit

fields.label: Operating compensation
fields.help: Choose the proposed mix of fee and store performance.

options.text: $18,000 guaranteed plus a small opening bonus.
$22,000 fixed management fee.
$4,000 guaranteed plus 18% of store operating profit, uncapped.
$9,000 guaranteed plus 9% of store operating profit, capped at $45,000.

fields.label: Launch commitment
fields.help: Choose the operating footprint to lock before local sales are known.

options.text: Reserve the full space and expanded team, with a reduced layout available and a capped sales bonus.
Commit your holiday team to the largest full-space concept now; the brand funds space and inventory, while most of your fee depends on profit.
Run a paid weekend market test before signing a pop-up lease.
Open a small counter with weekly inventory replenishment.

workflows.title: Outcome-linked analytics dashboard
workflows.scenario: A climate consultancy wants a client-facing dashboard. Three large customers requested it, but renewals will be negotiated after a prototype demonstration.
facts: Customer-weighted cases put the variable packages near the fixed fee

fields.label: Commercial package
fields.help: Choose the payment structure for design and build.

options.text: $54,000 guaranteed across delivery milestones.
$43,000 guaranteed plus a $15,000 renewal milestone.
$22,000 retainer plus 4% of attributable renewal value, capped at $110,000.
$10,000 upfront plus 10% of attributable renewal value, uncapped.

fields.label: Technical commitment
fields.help: Choose how much integration work to begin before renewals sign.

options.text: Build all three new integrations and staff launch support before renewals; vendor costs are covered and half the fee depends on retained revenue.
Reserve the full build team and implement all three customer integrations, with a capped renewal milestone.
Build the shared dashboard core, adding integrations after customer approval.
Deliver a paid clickable prototype before beginning integrations.

workflows.title: Trade-show hardware demonstration
workflows.scenario: A hardware company needs an interactive demonstration for a major trade show. The engineering sample works in the lab, although the production enclosure is unfinished.
facts: The company covers booth hardware and production vendors

fields.label: Demonstration package
fields.help: Choose the proposed fee and lead-generation upside.

options.text: $31,000 guaranteed plus a small delivery bonus.
$38,000 guaranteed before the show.
$7,000 guaranteed plus 6% of first-year qualified sales, uncapped; expenses remain covered.
$14,000 guaranteed plus 3% of first-year qualified sales, capped at $85,000.

fields.label: Build commitment
fields.help: Choose the demonstration scope to lock before production testing completes.

options.text: Build the full interactive booth around live hardware, with a simplified backup and a capped lead bonus.
Make the untested production enclosure the live centerpiece while keeping the lab unit in reserve; costs are covered and most compensation tracks sales.
Deliver a paid tabletop prototype before committing to the trade-show booth.
Build a standard booth around the lab-proven features only.
